text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the
shopping
district...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: WHOOOAAAYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Her heartfelt songs will bring life to
this
shopping
district! Well, what do you
think of the plan?!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
What do I think of it? Uhhh...
It'll be too loud and
distracting. I'm sorry, but
having concerts in the shopping district
might not be a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what the heck! If you don't get my
sound,
then I don't even wanna play
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wham!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Glad I caught you in time. Sorry
for
grabbing your arm so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good. You'll have to forgive her,
though. She
tends to lose sight of her
surroundings when she's
mad.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
My bad. It's just, we can't find a venue
for my
concert...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This gal here's ready to go big! She's
moving off
the streets and onto her first
stage performance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can vouch for her exceeding musical
talent! I
first heard her sing in front of
the station, and I
was moved to my core!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You're the only one who really
gets my
genius, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! One day, the world will realize it
too. Now
come on, let's keep looking for
your stage!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which... You wouldn't
happen to
know a place we can hold a
performance, would
you?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Waaarrrghhh! THANK YOU!
choice_data_list: Shall we try looking for it together?
Wanna try looking for it together?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And there you have it! Didn't that just
kickstart
your heart?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
U-um... Sorry, but her music doesn't
really fit the
cafe's atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but we've got a young and hip
clientele
here, so... Oh, I know! Can you
perform disco?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Tch! Does it look like I can?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This place is quite relaxing, but what do
you say
to livening it up with some rock
music?
choice_data_list: T-Then let's go somewhere that mat...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... To be honest, I'm not really
feeling it.
Why not just perform at a club
if you're doing
rock?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: UUUGH!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
This sucks! We're getting turned down
left and right! My music's just too
sophisticated for any of
them to
understand!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're right. There's only one way to make it big nowadays anyway—and that's to go viral!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, get this. A band I like, Santa
Monica,
started off by making a name
for themselves
online too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh... I guess there is that method.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
All right! Since we're doing this, let's
make a music video that'll really pop off!
C'mon, let's go see which of the studios
we know will let us use
their gear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There she goes, off to twist someone
else's arm. I
just hope she can get her
passion across
properly...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I think she's on a roll!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yep! She's the type to make staggering
gains in
the face of adversity. She's
tackling a chance for
growth head-on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She may be frustrated at how poorly
today went, but I bet this experience
will spark inspiration for
her
songwriting! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But in order for her to keep fighting,
she'll need a
strong support system.
choice_data_list: Now that you mention it, you might...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As determined and passionate as she is,
she'll
eventually break if she's constantly
buffeted by
opposing winds.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She needs a friend to catch her when
she's about
to fall. We all do, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I decided to be that pillar of support
from the
moment her singing stole my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And I learned a lot today too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry! Things will
definitely
work out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl makes her declaration
with full
confidence, and I can't help but
be impressed by
her conviction.
